name: Bandai (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Bandai town emblem in white: an outlined stylised mountain range of three peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Bandai, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 October 1964.

features.role: Bandai town emblem — an outlined stylised mountain range of three peaks
